question: Does partial CLIP visual fine-tuning improve the frozen-CLIP B4 natural-crop model?

data.test_policy: Do not read final-test images or labels

views: experiment-006 predicted-mask bbox natural crop with 10% context
inputs.preprocessing: B4 deterministic CLIP validation preprocessing; no augmentation
inputs.frozen_feature_arrays: used only to reproduce B4 train-only standardization statistics

model.name: B5
model.encoder: one shared OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 called for both views
model.frozen_visual: all earlier visual parameters and entire text tower
model.head: original 512->64 ReLU; crop 512->64 ReLU; concatenate; dropout 0.5; 128->5 Softplus

training.precision: CUDA float16 autocast with gradient scaling
training.selection: minimum development normalized nutrient MAE epoch independently per seed

evaluation.primary: mean energy/protein/carbohydrate/fat MAE divided by training means
evaluation.uncertainty: 1000 paired bootstrap draws of development plate groups, seed 0
